powerSchedule.title: Power schedule
powerSchedule.help: Manage power daily or on selected weekdays. Core continues when the browser is closed. Times missed while stopped are not replayed. Wake-on-LAN needs a running Core in the same cluster; sending a packet does not confirm that the PC started. Shutdown uses the normal OS command without forced termination.
powerSchedule.wakeAvailable: Wake interfaces are retained. Change the interface selection in the Wake-on-LAN tab.
powerSchedule.wakeMissing: Core has not retained wake interfaces yet. Previously observed interfaces are copied when saving. If the host has not been observed, discover its interfaces while it is running.
powerSchedule.saved: Power schedules were shared. Only enabled schedules will run.
powerSchedule.bulkHelp: Replace all schedules on the selected hosts with the list below, including time, weekdays and enabled state. Each host keeps its selected cluster. Nothing changes until you save.
powerSchedule.bulkToggleHelp: Change only the enabled state of all saved schedules on the selected hosts. Times, time zones, weekdays and actions are preserved. Hosts without schedules are unchanged.
powerSchedule.bulkUnavailable: Read settings for every selected host first. Refresh hosts with unconfirmed save results.
powerSchedule.bulkDrafts: Individual schedules have unsaved edits. Save or refresh them before using bulk settings.
powerSchedule.bulkChanged: The selected cluster, revision or edits changed after confirmation. Reopen bulk settings.
powerSchedule.bulkComplete: Bulk processing finished. Check the result for each host. Unconfirmed requests were not resent.
powerSchedule.invalid: Check the time, time zone, weekdays and action. Up to 32 schedules are supported per host.
powerSchedule.readUnavailable: Power schedules could not be read from the selected cluster.
powerSchedule.clusterUnavailable: The selected cluster's running coordinator is unavailable.
powerSchedule.hostUnknown: The target host's membership is unconfirmed. Configure it initially while it is running.
powerSchedule.saveUnconfirmed: The save result is unconfirmed. Read the current settings before sending another change.
powerSchedule.activationUnconfirmed: Settings were saved, but activation was not fully confirmed. Read the current settings.
powerSchedule.noTarget: No eligible Core is available in this cluster
powerSchedule.missed: Skipped because the execution window expired
host.power.scheduleExpired: The expired power schedule was not executed
host.power.scheduleAlreadyAccepted: This shutdown time was already accepted on this PC
host.power.scheduleClaimUnconfirmed: The PC could not persist the schedule claim and was not shut down
